async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Most starred' link to sort projects by stars
    most_starred_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Most starred')
    await most_starred_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Wait a bit for the page to update after sorting
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
    # Find all project headings or links in the main area
    # Based on the tree, project headings are level 2 headings with links inside
    # I'll get all heading level 2 elements that contain project links
    project_headings = page.get_by_role('heading', level=2)
    count = await project_headings.count()
    
    # Limit to top 5 projects
    top_n = min(5, count)
    
    for i in range(top_n):
        # Get the i-th project heading
        heading = project_headings.nth(i)
        # Get the link inside the heading (the project link)
        project_link = heading.get_by_role('link').first
        # Click the project link to navigate to the project page
        await project_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        
        # On the project page, find and click the star button
        # The star button might be a button with role 'button' and name containing 'Star' or similar
        # In GitLab, the star button often has a data-testid or specific class, but I'll use role and name
        # I'll look for a button with name that includes 'Star' (case-insensitive)
        star_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Star', exact=False)
        if await star_button.count() > 0:
            await star_button.click()
            # Wait for the star action to complete
            await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        else:
            # If not found, try alternative selectors or log an error
            print(f"Star button not found for project {i+1}")
        
        # Go back to the explore projects page to continue with next project
        await page.goto('/explore/projects/starred')
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        # Wait a bit for the list to reload
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    
    # After starring top 5, the task is complete
    print("Starred the top five most stared repos.")
